envelope.description: Generic read-only tool loop with an execution-time allowlist

body.title: Generic read-only tool loop with an execution-time allowlist
body.summary: Extract the tool loop and final structured emit from src/analyze/context/driver.ts behind a generic loop taking caller-supplied messages, answer schema, deadline, signal, retry policy and tool allowlist. Check every returned tool call's name (after alias resolution) against the allowlist before executeTool; a call outside it is refused with a tool error and logged. Pass the signal to every turn. Repoint runShaperToolLoop and runShaper's legacy tail at it with unchanged behaviour.
acceptanceChecks: The analyzer's existing tests for runShaperToolLoop and runShaper pass unchanged.
A returned call to a tool outside the allowlist, file_write included, never reaches executeTool.
Cancellation stops the loop within the turn in flight.

tests.name: src/agent/providers/__tests__/ollama-review-session.test.ts: 'cancelling an Ollama reviewer session mid tool loop aborts the in-flight turn and starts no further turn'
src/agent/providers/__tests__/ollama-review-session.test.ts: 'a returned file_write or Write call, or any tool outside the read-only allowlist, is refused before dispatch and never executed'
